description.text: About Qingdao University As one of the 50 Universities approved the qualification of enrolling international students by Ministry of Education, Qingdao University started enrollment of international students from 1987. Qingdao University was approved as HSK test center by Confucius Institute Headquarters (Hanban) in 1997. In 2016, over 1600 international students from 61 countries come to study at Qingdao University. Institute Introduction School of Data Science and Software Engineering (SDSSE) is one of the 34 schools of Qingdao University. The school has four departments, one teaching experimental training center and one students' innovative entrepreneurship center.The school attaches great importance to comprehensively improving the overall quality of students, encouraging students to attend interdisciplinary elective courses, lectures, academic competitions, and team cooperation training courses, to enhance students' communication skills, presentation skills, negotiation skills and team spirit. CoursesOffered Calculus Discrete mathematics Data structure Algorithm analysis Software testing Software architecture Big data processing Multimedia technology Network game design Software platform Program design Operating system Demand analysis Computer network Linear algebra Computer composition principle Object-oriented analysis & design Database system Software engineering introduction Software project management Embedded system Artificial intelligence Parallel computing Probability and statistics Mobile computing Data mining Virtual reality Chinese Integrated Chinese Culture Living Environment Students are expected to live in the International Students Dormitory, where single and double rooms are available. Every room is equipped with central heating facilities. Rooms have private shower baths and toilets; all rooms are installed with air-conditioners. Shared kitchens and washing machines are also accessible to students in the dormitory. The University campuses enjoy tranquil and convenient surroundings. All kinds of daily necessities are available in off-campus supermarkets at low prices. Post offices and banks are near the main gate of each campus. City bus routes connect all campuses with the downtown area, scenic spots, and the train station. Study Duration 4 Years Fee Structure Tuition Fee RMB 20,000/year Accommodation Fee RMB 11,000–13,000/year (Double room) Accommodation Deposit RMB 800/year Insurance Fee RMB 800/year

duration.text: The Software Engineering at Qingdao University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Transcript of high-school or college（The average scores should be higher than 70% and every subject should be higher than 60%. Or top 50% of NEET (for Indian Applicants).） 6.Application Form 7.Resume (personal and family conditions, study and work experience) 8.Guarantee Statement FOR studying program at Qingdao University *All documents mentioned above should be written in Chinese or English and should be an original or notarized copy.
